details.definition: final minus initial complete Shelter count, including daughter-camp boot shelters

methods.bootstrap: 2,000 whole-world resamples; fresh numpy.default_rng(0) per statistic; percentile 95% CI; undefined draws excluded with valid count; F6 keeps seed pairs together
methods.F1: Pooled living nonelder adults at exact elapsed day60 (after tick86399); partner must be alive and mutual; dead partner pointers do not count
methods.F2: Pooled births with fallback=false from one-based elapsed simulation day20; simulation_day=tick//1440+1, tick>=27360; display-clock offset does not change inclusion; all daily births/fallbacks retained
methods.F3: Pooled Pearson for each temperament axis, then mean four axes for siblings minus unrelated; each unique unordered pair contributes both orientations; bar>=0.06 and lower95%CI>0; exact per-world integer sufficient statistics preserve whole-world bootstrap
methods.F3_eligibility: Full siblings are all recorded people with both known matching ordered mother/father, including fallback births, independent of residence or coexistence. Their first shared hourly snapshot in a non-null settlement supplies reference tick/settlement/stages when present; otherwise all three are null, without excluding the pair. Unrelated controls exclude direct parent-child or any shared known parent across either slot, and use their first shared hourly snapshot in the same non-null settlement regardless of life-stage categories. Sibling stage-pair categories describe observed shared context only and never filter either population. Unassigned settlement=null observations cannot form unrelated same-settlement pairs; their counts are reported. Unknown founder kinship is not inferred. Empty worlds remain in resampling; pair IDs/ticks/stages reported
methods.F4: 20:00 snapshots; each mutual living couple counted once if both have beds; same bed tile means shared shelter; bedless person-nights separately reported
methods.F5: Only completed fissions; pooled split couples / mutual living couples in parent settlements at departure; raw membership and household partitions verify numerator; zero denominator ERROR
methods.F6: Identical R2 definitions: equal-world alive/death/shelter means, noon settlement-summed stores averaged within worlds then across worlds; primary social rate pools adult completions/adult-days, mean world rate sensitivity
methods.shelters: Final minus initial complete Shelter count, including daughter-camp boot shelters
methods.errors: Missing/malformed observations or proof ERROR; undefined fractions/correlations ERROR, never artificial zero; measured bar misses FAIL with numeric estimates; absent F7/F8 tuning-only PENDING
methods.evidence: F7 schema1 stageb requires I1-I5 plus v19/v20 pins and verifies every file hash; F8 schema1 stageb re-verifies complete raw performance evidence with unchanged timing bars
